name: AI automations
author: Brett
description: Toggleable automation rules: a voice phrase, a schedule (work@1 job), a new git push on a watched repo (polled through the AI/hub session until axHub has a git feed), notes tagged #build or #ask, and "the orchestrator finished a build" → a read-back summary note. Actions: ask Claude (reply saved as a note), hand to the AI build bridge, read back, run an action. Pure rule evaluation.

placeholders.git-feed: latest commit read through an ai.chat turn on the hub session until axHub offers a git head API

hostActions.axnotes.notes.saved: the app dispatches it after saving a note (payload = the note JSON)
hostActions.axnotes.notes.save: the app saves a note from payload {title, text, tags[], source}
hostActions.ai-build-bridge.finished: watched: the orchestrator finished a build
hostActions.ai-build-bridge.request: dispatched for #build rules when the bridge is installed
